chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:

key_terms.اغْسِلْ: wash; an imperative command indicating instruction
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith

ai.seo_question: What should be done to the hands after waking from sleep before wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction connected to taharah and wudu (ablution), directing that the hand be washed once after sleep. It reflects the care of Islamic law for cleanliness and preparation before acts of worship.
